title: The pitch page shows what access Chatticus needs in the customer AWS account
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the published IAM policy, in the provisioning epic
- **Runs in parallel with:** the rest of this epic
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
Asking someone to let a beta-stage company assume a role in their AWS account and launch EC2 is a far larger ask than an API key. The people qualified to say yes are exactly the people who will read the policy first.

Publishing it converts better than offering to send it. Linking to a template they can read before they fill in anything is the whole argument.

**Done when:** the scenario exists and fails for the right reason.
